description: Opus R unit 1: a mid-turn switch-out runs no Update before it leaves. Champions' Eject Button keeps the U-turn user's own flag, so Swampert (Eject Button, Unnerve, faster) and Snorlax (U-turn user, Sitrus Berry at 100/267) are both asked to switch. Showdown sets skipBeforeSwitchOutEventFlag at the request, so neither instaswitch runs BeforeSwitchOut and its Update: after Swampert leaves (its Unnerve gone), Snorlax switches out without eating the berry. An Update before Snorlax's switch-out would let it eat. Damage rolls and the critical hit branch.
